bundle.shortDescription: Run your whole school in one place.
bundle.longDescription: DigitGlance School — scores and WAEC-style report cards, attendance, online fee collection with branded receipts, bursary reports, and a parent portal for every family, plus the DigitGlance AI assistant drafting remarks and lesson notes. The full DigitGlance School product in a dedicated, secure native window.
